free_tier_limits: Public Node API is free. Freemium includes 200M API credits/month. Public and Freemium Node API guarantee about 1,800 requests/min across all endpoints; Freemium Advanced API allows 50 requests/min, capped at 500 per 10 min.
rate_limits: Public/Freemium Node API: about 1,800 requests/min guaranteed across all endpoints, with more possible depending on load. Freemium Advanced API: 50 requests/min, maximum 500/10 min. Premium Node API: up to about 1,500 requests/sec per endpoint, or 4,000/sec for Solana; Advanced API: 1,000+/min.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: ORIGINAL 'unknown' is incorrect; Ankr's current Service Plans page publishes the free quotas and limits: https://www.ankr.com/docs/rpc-service/service-plans/ . rate_limits: ORIGINAL 'not published' is incorrect; the official rate-limit table specifies Public, Freemium, and Premium limits: https://www.ankr.com/docs/rpc-service/service-plans/ .
